stumbles.quote: Thick film sinks toward your phone's tilt while black film spreads from the top until it pops.
stumbles.why: Unclear what 'black film' is (a thinned region?) and why it spreads from the top. Without soap-film physics, 'thick' and 'black' look unrelated, and 'pops' is not explained.

stumbles.quote: An interference LUT gives colour to 0.07 mean ΔE76.
stumbles.why: 'LUT' and 'ΔE76' are not defined. It doesn't say what the colour is compared against, so I can't tell what 0.07 means.

stumbles.quote: checked only on a software GPU.
stumbles.why: Unclear whether it works on real GPUs or phones. It also clashes with the phone-tilt feature, which a software GPU can't test.
The build date is unexplained. It's unclear whether it matters, for example for WebGPU support.

point: A WebGPU compute demo of a soap film that responds to phone tilt, thins to black, and pops, with colours matched to interference physics. It has only been tested on a software GPU.
